page.notes: Doubtful: "cap.27" in the left-margin note may read "cap.i27"; checked as printed where legible. The note marks d and e stand in the text before "Sine dubio" and "Hunc". The top line is cut off by the scan edge, so the paragraph begins mid-sentence. The long s is printed as f-like forms, so "esset", "obstupefactis" and "infestarent" are written with plain s. The line-end "boni-" is a printed hyphen that continues on the next page. The ę in "sepulturę" is read from the scan.
